text: (1) Scanned copyof valid passport’s information page;(2)Scanned copyof notarized highest Academic Degree Certificate, Expected Graduation Certificatefor fresh graduates (original one and English-translated one. After being pre-admitted, applicants are required to submit final Graduation Certificate to be eligible for official admission.);(3) Scanned copies of transcriptof all courses during the highest academic degree education(original one and English-translated one);(4) Study Plan: A minimum of 1000 words for master’s degree applicants (general scholars) and a minimum of 1500 words for doctoraldegree applicants (senior scholars) written in Chinese (Chinese medium applicants) or English (English medium applicants). The content includes personal studying and working experiences, academic research achievements, research and learning plans during master or doctoral study, personal developing goals after graduation, etc.;(5)Two original copies of recommendation letters written by professors or associate professors in Chinese or English (with signatures and contact information); only postgraduate candidates are required to submit;(6) Provisional Acceptance Letter from a professor of Southern Medical University(only postgraduate candidates are required to submit);(7)Scanned copy of Foreigner's Physical Examination Formcompleted in Chinese or English;(8)Certificate of language proficiency;(9) Police Clearance Certificate(10)ID photo (2-inch blue background photo without hats);(11) English or Chinese self-introduction video (3-5 minutes, no more than 50M).
